user.title: Data Engineer | Building Scalable Data & AI Solutions
user.about: Data Engineer with experience designing, building, and deploying scalable data and AI solutions in cloud environments. I build reliable pipelines, REST APIs, and machine learning deployments that turn complex data into valuable business insight.
user.aboutLead: I combine a software-engineering foundation with practical cloud and AI expertise to deliver thoughtful, production-ready systems.

sectionLabels.contactText: I am open to conversations about data platforms, AI-powered products, and cloud engineering opportunities.

experience.description: Designing and building scalable cloud-native data and AI solutions.
duties: Designed scalable data engineering solutions supporting AI-driven products.
Built and maintained cloud-native backend services.
Developed RESTful APIs for internal platforms.
Automated software delivery through CI/CD pipelines.
Deployed machine learning models into production on AWS.
Collaborated with software engineers, data scientists and product teams.
Contributed to technical design discussions and code reviews.

experience.description: Supported IT and Computer Science students through practical teaching, assessment, and one-to-one guidance.
duties: Invigilated semester tests with care and integrity.
Marked tests and weekly assignments with clear feedback.
Delivered individual and group tutoring for IT and Computer Science students.
achievements: Translated complex concepts into approachable learning experiences.
Balanced assessment responsibilities with student mentorship.

education.description: Specialised in cybersecurity, data protection, and phishing-email detection using Natural Language Processing.
Built a rigorous foundation in mathematical modelling, analytics, and computational problem-solving.
Completed a science-focused curriculum that established a foundation for further technical study.

projects.description: Participated in the MosquitoAlert Challenge 2023, developing and evaluating deep learning models for mosquito species classification using transfer learning and computer vision techniques. The solution supported accurate image-based identification for vector surveillance and public health research.

projects.projName: Android Mobile POS App for Street Vendors
projects.description: Developed an Android point-of-sale application for informal traders featuring inventory management, sales recording, customer management, and business analytics. Designed to simplify day-to-day business operations through an intuitive mobile experience.

Participated in the SACAIR2023 competition, developing and evaluating deep learning models for satellite image classification through feature engineering, model optimisation, and performance evaluation.

Developed PhishHunter, a phishing email detection system using Natural Language Processing and machine learning. Evaluated TF-IDF, Word2Vec, and Doc2Vec text representations with classifiers including Logistic Regression and SVM to improve phishing detection accuracy.

Contributed to the design and development of scalable enterprise data and AI solutions, building cloud-native data pipelines, backend APIs, automated CI/CD workflows, and machine learning deployment processes for production environments.
